title: Short Selling
description: How to make money when a stock goes down.

slides.title: Betting against a company
slides.content: Normally you buy low and sell high. What if you think a company is garbage and the stock will crash? You can 'Short Sell' it.

slides.title: How it works
slides.content: 1. You BORROW shares from your broker. 2. You immediately SELL them at the high price. 3. Later, you BUY them back at the low price and RETURN them to the broker.

slides.title: Infinite Risk
slides.content: When you buy a stock normally, the worst that happens is it goes to $0. When you short a stock, there is NO limit to how high the price can go. You could lose infinitely more money than you invested!

quiz.question: What is the correct order of operations for short selling?

options.text: Borrow & sell high, then buy back low & return
options.explanation: You sell first, and buy back later to cover your position.

quiz.question: Why is short selling considered extremely risky?

options.text: Because brokers charge a $1,000 fee to do it
Because a stock's price can technically rise infinitely, meaning infinite potential losses
options.explanation: If you short a stock and it skyrockets (like GameStop), your losses have no cap.

options.text: Because the government monitors short sellers
